title: The Nihilist Reading Of The House of the Seven Gables (film) #Shorts
description:
The feeling that The House of the Seven Gables (film) means something is a chemical event with an evolutionary address. The House of the Seven Gables is a 1940 Gothic drama film based on the 1851 novel of the same name by Nathaniel Hawthorne. It stars George Sanders, Margaret Lindsay, and Vincent Price, and tells the story of a family consumed by greed in which one brother frames another for murder.

What culture calls destiny in The House of the Seven Gables (film) is usually just selection pressure wearing a suit. Price was cast most likely because he had forged a good working relationship with Kelly and May in October 1939 while working on The Invisible Man Returns. The studio announced Price's and Lindsay's casting, along with those of Nan Grey and George Sanders, on December 29.
